item.title: Robert Pattinson's Batman Movie Franchise Is Officially Finished
item.description: With Robert Pattinson confirmed to be the next James Bond , one of the biggest takeaways is that Matt Reeves’ The Batman series will likely end with The Batman: Part II . Pattinson is signed on for three films as Bond, and while that’s one less film than the four-film deal that Amazon MGM Studios was seeking for the other Bond contenders, it’s pretty hard to imagine that Pattinson will juggle the role of 007 with an ongoing commitment to DC — much less Battinson’s integration into the wider DCU, which some DC fans had hoped for. To be clear, nothing has been confirmed about the status of a third The Batman movie, but the latest news combined with the extreme delays facing The Batman Part II feel like a pretty clear indication that the Batmobile has hit a dead end and will need yet another reboot.

item.title: Magic: The Gathering Turns a Fan-Favorite Star Trek Character Into a Commander Staple
item.description: Like many Magic: The Gathering Universes Beyond sets, the Star Trek crossover feels built for Commander. Not only does it include four preconstructed Commander decks, but it’s packed with legendary creatures and spacecraft that can serve as your Commander or neatly slot into the deck’s other 99 cards. One of the most versatile cards in the set works in several Commander archetypes but could also easily fit in Limited and competitive constructed decks. It pays tribute to one of the best Star Trek characters, while borrowing mechanics from a very different Universes Beyond set.

item.title: Amazon Officially Reveals Early Black Friday Gaming Deals
item.description: Your calendar might mark Nov. 27 as Black Friday, but the reality is that retailers treat the entire month like a discount event. Sales for major gaming products are staggered throughout the month, as evidenced by Amazon's self-described early Black Friday deals. The online retailer has earmarked a wide range of games for every taste in these deals, from recent action titles to critical darlings and everything in between.

item.title: Star Wars: Fate of the Old Republic Director Teases Big Announcements
item.description: When Casey Hudson, the creator of Mass Effect, announced he was working on Star Wars: Fate of the Old Republic , fans were ecstatic. Following the closure of Mass Effect developer BioWare and the cancellation of the next game in the series, excitement for Fate of the Old Republic has somehow grown even larger. But we haven't heard much about the spiritual successor to Knights of the Old Republic , which Hudson also directed, since it was revealed back in 2025. According to Hudson, however, the wait for news is almost over.

item.title: Game Awards 2026: All Game of the Year Front-Runners and Predictions
item.description: At this point, we have a clear idea of what games will be favored by The Game Awards' voting body : A high Metacritic rating (preferably over 90) is a must; role-playing games and action-adventures are strongly favored, as are games with strong narrative elements; indie and multiplayer games struggle harder for recognition than AAA single-player adventures. We used these metrics to correctly predict last year's winner, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 , and the 2024 winner, Astro Bot . In 2025, we also predicted all six GOTY nominees and correctly called 20 other categories.

item.title: Avengers: Secret Wars Will Be ‘Whole Other Genre,’ Marvel Boss Says
item.description: While Avengers: Secret Wars has largely been a mystery, Kevin Feige’s latest description of the 2027 film offers a bit more context. In an interview with Empire , Kevin Feige said that Secret Wars “is a whole other genre of story” compared to the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday . While that comment will be more useful once Doomsday releases on Dec. 18, Feige seems to be hinting that the movie won’t be quite as grim as Doomsday , which is expected to be a multiversal bloodbath.

item.title: GTA 6's Official First Updates Are Great News For Fans
item.description: Hopefully you've still got room on your hard drive after preloading the hefty Grand Theft Auto 6 in anticipation of its impending release day. You've got at least one more thing you need to download if you want to enjoy Rockstar's open-world game the moment it goes live on Nov. 19, though. Here's what you need to know about when you can download the GTA 6 update — and what's reportedly inside.
